threads.body: [Testing] Use the exact attribute assertion here. The non-exact variant silently accepts unexpected attributes, weakening this regression test if the configured URL is ever emitted elsewhere; the surrounding query tests enumerate the complete expected attribute set.

replies.body:
Addressed in c872d8c37afb7cfe6bf45cdcff513b1aae295fbe.

Analysis: The test checked only the target fields with a non-exact assertion even though the query span emits database attributes in both semantic-convention modes. Enumerating the complete expected set makes the configured URL regression test reject any unexpected attribute.

Upsides: The test now catches configured URL data emitted under an unintended attribute and stays consistent with the surrounding query tests.

Downsides: Intended changes to the query attribute set will require updating this assertion.
